subject: Post-call compliance next steps — SOC 2 / DDQ / portal access
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma.larson@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call compliance next steps — SOC 2 / DDQ / portal access

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock procurement and the security review on our side:

1) Docs we need from NovaHealth:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12-month period) and bridge letter if available
   - Vendor security questionnaire (we'll start with the attached DDQ template)
   - Any supplementary evidence in your trust portal (system configs, control descriptions)

2) Questions that came up from our security team:
   - Is the SOC 2 report fully shareable or will it be redacted? If redactions, which sections?
   - Do you have a Data Processing Agreement and/or HIPAA BAAs for PHI-handling customers?
   - Where is PII/PHI stored (region) and what encryption-at-rest controls are in place?

3) Proposed timeline:
   - Today: Nova to provision trust portal read-only access for our security reviewers (7-day window ok)
   - +2 business days: we load the DDQ and flag follow-up evidence requests
   - +5 business days: aim to have bridge letter and SOC2 link/attachment delivered

Action items: Emma to send portal invite and SOC2 artifact; Ben/Dev to confirm internal reviewers and any procurement items. I'm attaching our DDQ checklist to speed things up.

If we can get a portal invite by EOD that would be ideal. Thanks — talk soon.

—
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Emma Larson <emma.larson@novahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novahealth.com
Date: 2027-09-29T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call compliance next steps — SOC 2 / DDQ / portal access

Thanks Soojin — great to speak earlier. Short answers and what we'll provide: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we have the most recent Type II (covering 2026-07 through 2027-06). We typically provide a redacted PDF to prospects; I attached a redacted export here for your initial review (NovaHealth_SOC2_T2_redacted.pdf).

- Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter. I'll send a draft by tomorrow for your legal team to review.

- Trust portal: I've created a read-only access link for the reviewers you listed. Portal contains control matrices, sample evidence, and our incident response runbook. The invite link is below (temporary credentials will be sent in a separate secure message).

Portal invite: https://trustvault.novahealth.com/invite/ABCD-1234

- HIPAA / GDPR: We have a Data Processing Addendum that covers GDPR; for HIPAA customers we execute a BAA — please confirm if NovaHealth will be processing PHI for this proof-of-concept. If yes, we'll prioritize the BAA paperwork.

Attachments included: NovaHealth_SOC2_T2_redacted.pdf

I'll follow up with the bridge letter and a short note with the portal credentials (sent securely). Let me know if you want me to add anyone else to the portal access list.

Best,
Emma
Head of Security Operations
NovaHealth
emma.larson@novahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Larson <emma.larson@novahealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call compliance next steps — SOC 2 / DDQ / portal access

Thanks Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of quick points from the deal/ops side:

- Deal info: this is for NovaHealth POC (deal NH-2027-4932). Procurement will likely need the SOC2 and bridge letter attached to a contract package.
- Contact for contracts: please loop in contracts@redwood.com or feel free to send the bridge letter to me and I'll get it to legal for inclusion in the purchase order.
- Portal access: please confirm which document folders will be visible (Control Matrices, Network Diagrams, Sys Configs, RSA reports, IR runbooks). If any are limited, note that so our reviewers can prioritize what to request next.

I'll coordinate timing with our security reviewers once the portal link/credentials arrive. Thanks — Ben

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Emma Larson <emma.larson@novahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call compliance next steps — SOC 2 / DDQ / portal access

All — portal access is now provisioned. Notes below and attachments included.

- Access: read-only link (https://trustvault.novahealth.com/invite/ABCD-1234). Temporary password will arrive in a secure separate e-mail to the individual reviewers; links expire in 7 days.
- Visible folders: Control Matrices, System Architecture Diagrams, Incident Response Runbook, Sample Evidence (logs, configuration snapshots). Network diagrams and select penetration-test reports are marked restricted — please request if needed and we'll route to legal for an extra NDA if required.
- Bridge letter: attached as a template; we'll sign and return the finalized bridge letter once you confirm the PO/contract path.
- DPA/BAA: we have standard templates; I'll add the Privacy contact on the next message.

Attachments: bridge_letter-template.pdf, portal-invite.txt

If reviewers have specific artifact requests, send a bullet list and I'll queue them for upload. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up if that helps.

Emma
Head of Security Operations
NovaHealth
emma.larson@novahealth.com
